## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `claude plugin validate .`
- [ ] `claude plugin test .`
- [ ] Reviewed staged changes for credentials and private data.

## Checklist

- [ ] User-facing text and documentation are in English.
- [ ] No API keys, access tokens, private keys, or passwords are included.
- [ ] Documentation reflects any user-visible behavior changes.
